UPSTREAM: soc/intel/braswell: add default option to use public FSP The current Braswell FSP 1.1 header in vendorcode/intel, for which there is no publicly available FSP binary, contains silicon init UPDs which are not found in the publicly available header/binary in the FSP Github repo. This prevents new boards from being added which use the public Braswell FSP header/binary. To resolve this, move the UPDs not found in the public header from the soc's chip.c to ramstage.c for the boards which use them. Add a Kconfig option to use the current non-public FSP header and select it for boards which need it (google/cyan variants); set the public FSP option as the default. Use the Kconfig option to set FSP_HEADER_PATH to ensure the correct header is used. Test: build google/cyan and intel/strago using non-public and public FSP header/binaries respectively. tast-tests: Avoid flakiness in security.SandboxedServices. While I haven't seen any recent failures in the lab, I think it's possible to further reduce the chance of future flakiness in the security.SandboxedServices test. I'm making us ignore process trees rooted by executables in /usr/local (which is usually mounted noexec when dev mode is disabled), and also ignore process trees containing "autotest" in their command lines (previously the test just ignored individual processes containing "autotest"). I'm also preemtively adding metrics_client to the baseline, as I believe that it's used by various periodically-executed scripts.
